data.narrative:
Danti is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Jesse Kallman and Martice Nicks III. The firm has raised $10.9M to date. The relevant comp universe spans 6 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private-stage companies including Starcloud, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Of three valuation approaches considered, only Stage-Progression was applicable. This method uses the $10.9M total raised as a value proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $27M. Peer-Median analysis was not feasible: while 14 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, similar valuation tier) yielded fewer than the required 3 comparable datapoints. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because Danti's revenue is not disclosed; the public Space & Aerospace median P/S stands at 25.3x across 5 tickers, but remains unusable without target financials.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $31M, with a median point of $27M. This range reflects conservative 15% downside and upside sensitivity around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of reliable peer revenue multiples for early-stage aerospace firms, lack of visibility into Danti's current burn rate and unit economics, and the stage-progression multiplier's sensitivity to market conditions and capital availability.
